verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ בִּנְגִינֹ֗ת מַשְׂכִּ֥יל לְדָוִֽד׃ הַאֲזִ֣ינָה תְּפִלָּתִ֑י אֱ֭לֹהִים וְאַל־ תִּ֝תְעַלַּ֗ם מִתְּחִנָּתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ bin·ḡî·nōṯ maś·kîl lə·ḏā·wiḏ ha·’ă·zî·nāh tə·p̄il·lā·ṯî ’ĕ·lō·hîm wə·’al- tiṯ·‘al·lam mit·tə·ḥin·nā·ṯî
verses.literal: For the choirmaster With stringed instruments A Maskil of David Listen to my prayer O God and do not ignore my plea

verses.original: הַקְשִׁ֣יבָה לִּ֣י וַעֲנֵ֑נִי אָרִ֖יד בְּשִׂיחִ֣י וְאָהִֽימָה׃
verses.transliteration: haq·šî·ḇāh lî wa·‘ă·nê·nî ’ā·rîḏ bə·śî·ḥî wə·’ā·hî·māh
verses.literal: Attend to me and answer me I am restless in my complaint and distraught

verses.original: מִקּ֤וֹל אוֹיֵ֗ב מִפְּנֵ֣י עָקַ֣ת רָשָׁ֑ע כִּי־ יָמִ֥יטוּ אָ֝֗וֶן עָלַ֥י יִשְׂטְמֽוּנִי׃ וּבְאַ֥ף
verses.transliteration: miq·qō·wl ’ō·w·yêḇ mip·pə·nê ‘ā·qaṯ rā·šā‘ kî- yā·mî·ṭū ’ā·wen ‘ā·lay yiś·ṭə·mū·nî ū·ḇə·’ap̄
verses.literal: at the voice of the enemy at the pressure of the wicked For they bring down disaster upon me and resent me in their anger

verses.original: לִ֭בִּי יָחִ֣יל בְּקִרְבִּ֑י וְאֵימ֥וֹת מָ֝֗וֶת נָפְל֥וּ עָלָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: lib·bî yā·ḥîl bə·qir·bî wə·’ê·mō·wṯ mā·weṯ nā·p̄ə·lū ‘ā·lāy
verses.literal: My heart pounds within me and the terrors of death assail me

verses.original: יִרְאָ֣ה וָ֭רַעַד יָ֣בֹא בִ֑י פַּלָּצֽוּת׃ וַ֝תְּכַסֵּ֗נִי
verses.transliteration: yir·’āh wā·ra·‘aḏ yā·ḇō ḇî pal·lā·ṣūṯ wat·tə·ḵas·sê·nî
verses.literal: Fear and trembling grip me and horror has overwhelmed me

verses.original: וָאֹמַ֗ר מִֽי־ יִתֶּן־ לִּ֣י אֵ֭בֶר כַּיּוֹנָ֗ה אָע֥וּפָה וְאֶשְׁכֹּֽנָה׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ō·mar mî- yit·ten- lî ’ê·ḇer kay·yō·w·nāh ’ā·‘ū·p̄āh wə·’eš·kō·nāh
verses.literal: I said Oh that I had wings like a dove I would fly away and find rest

verses.original: הִ֭נֵּה אַרְחִ֣יק נְדֹ֑ד בַּמִּדְבָּ֣ר אָלִ֖ין סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh ’ar·ḥîq nə·ḏōḏ bam·miḏ·bār ’ā·lîn se·lāh
verses.literal: How far away I would flee In the wilderness I would remain Selah

verses.original: אָחִ֣ישָׁה מִפְלָ֣ט לִ֑י מֵר֖וּחַ סֹעָ֣ה מִסָּֽעַר׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḥî·šāh mip̄·lāṭ lî mê·rū·aḥ sō·‘āh mis·sā·‘ar
verses.literal: I would hurry to my shelter far from this raging . . . tempest

verses.original: אֲ֭דֹנָי בַּלַּ֣ע פַּלַּ֣ג לְשׁוֹנָ֑ם כִּֽי־ רָאִ֨יתִי חָמָ֖ס וְרִ֣יב בָּעִֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·ḏō·nāy bal·la‘ pal·laḡ lə·šō·w·nām kî- rā·’î·ṯî ḥā·mās wə·rîḇ bā·‘îr
verses.literal: O Lord confuse and confound their speech for I see violence and strife in the city

verses.original: יוֹמָ֤ם וָלַ֗יְלָה יְסוֹבְבֻ֥הָ עַל־ חוֹמֹתֶ֑יהָ וְאָ֖וֶן וְעָמָ֣ל בְּקִרְבָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: yō·w·mām wā·lay·lāh yə·sō·wḇ·ḇu·hā ‘al- ḥō·w·mō·ṯe·hā wə·’ā·wen wə·‘ā·māl bə·qir·bāh
verses.literal: Day and night they encircle . . . the walls while malice and trouble [lie] within

verses.original: הַוּ֥וֹת בְּקִרְבָּ֑הּ תֹּ֣ךְ וּמִרְמָֽה׃ וְֽלֹא־ יָמִ֥ישׁ מֵ֝רְחֹבָ֗הּ
verses.transliteration: haw·wō·wṯ bə·qir·bāh tōḵ ū·mir·māh wə·lō- yā·mîš mê·rə·ḥō·ḇāh
verses.literal: Destruction [is] within oppression and deceit never leave the streets

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֹֽא־ אוֹיֵ֥ב יְחָֽרְפֵ֗נִי וְאֶ֫שָּׂ֥א לֹֽא־ מְ֭שַׂנְאִי הִגְדִּ֑יל עָלַ֣י מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃ וְאֶסָּתֵ֥ר
verses.transliteration: kî lō- ’ō·w·yêḇ yə·ḥā·rə·p̄ê·nî wə·’eś·śā lō- mə·śan·’î hiḡ·dîl ‘ā·lay mim·men·nū wə·’es·sā·ṯêr
verses.literal: For it is not an enemy who insults me that I could endure It is not a foe who rises against me from him I could hide

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה אֱנ֣וֹשׁ כְּעֶרְכִּ֑י אַ֝לּוּפִ֗י וּמְיֻדָּֽעִי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh ’ĕ·nō·wōš kə·‘er·kî ’al·lū·p̄î ū·mə·yud·dā·‘î
verses.literal: But it is you a man like myself my companion and close friend

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר נַמְתִּ֣יק ס֑וֹד יַ֭חְדָּו נְהַלֵּ֥ךְ בְּרָֽגֶשׁ׃ בְּבֵ֥ית אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer nam·tîq sō·wḏ yaḥ·dāw nə·hal·lêḵ bə·rā·ḡeš bə·ḇêṯ ’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: We shared sweet fellowship together we walked with the crowd into the house of God

verses.original: יַשִּׁימָוֶת עָלֵ֗ימוֹ יֵרְד֣וּ שְׁא֣וֹל חַיִּ֑ים כִּֽי־ רָע֖וֹת בְּקִרְבָּֽם׃ בִּמְגוּרָ֣ם
verses.transliteration: yaš·šī·må̄·wɛṯ ʿå̄·lē·mō yê·rə·ḏū šə·’ō·wl ḥay·yîm kî- rā·‘ō·wṯ bə·qir·bām bim·ḡū·rām
verses.literal: Let death seize them by surprise . . . let them go down to Sheol alive for evil is with them in their homes

verses.original: אֲ֭נִי אֶקְרָ֑א אֶל־ אֱלֹהִ֣ים וַ֝יהוָ֗ה יוֹשִׁיעֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·nî ’eq·rā ’el- ’ĕ·lō·hîm Yah·weh yō·wō·šî·‘ê·nî
verses.literal: But I call to God and the LORD saves me

verses.original: וָבֹ֣קֶר וְ֭צָהֳרַיִם עֶ֤רֶב וְאֶהֱמֶ֑ה אָשִׂ֣יחָה וַיִּשְׁמַ֥ע קוֹלִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wā·ḇō·qer wə·ṣā·ho·ra·yim ‘e·reḇ wə·’e·hĕ·meh ’ā·śî·ḥāh way·yiš·ma‘ qō·w·lî
verses.literal: Morning noon and night I cry out in distress and He hears my voice

verses.original: פָּ֘דָ֤ה נַ֭פְשִׁי בְשָׁל֣וֹם מִקֲּרָב־ לִ֑י כִּֽי־ בְ֝רַבִּ֗ים הָי֥וּ עִמָּדִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: pā·ḏāh nap̄·šî ḇə·šā·lō·wm miq·qă·rāḇ- lî kî- ḇə·rab·bîm hā·yū ‘im·mā·ḏî
verses.literal: He redeems my soul in peace from the battle [waged] against me even though many oppose me

verses.original: אֵ֨ל׀ יִשְׁמַ֤ע׀ וְֽיַעֲנֵם֮ וְיֹ֤שֵׁ֥ב קֶ֗דֶם סֶ֥לָה אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֵ֣ין חֲלִיפ֣וֹת לָ֑מוֹ וְלֹ֖א יָרְא֣וּ אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ’êl yiš·ma‘ wə·ya·‘ă·nêm wə·yō·šêḇ qe·ḏem se·lāh ’ă·šer ’ên ḥă·lî·p̄ō·wṯ lā·mōw wə·lō yā·rə·’ū ’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: God will hear and humiliate them the One enthroned for the ages Selah because they do not change and they have no fear of God

verses.original: שָׁלַ֣ח יָ֭דָיו בִּשְׁלֹמָ֗יו חִלֵּ֥ל בְּרִיתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: šā·laḥ yā·ḏāw biš·lō·māw ḥil·lêl bə·rî·ṯōw
verses.literal: My companion attacks . . . his friends he violates his covenant

verses.original: פִּיו֮ חָלְק֤וּ׀ מַחְמָאֹ֣ת וּֽקֲרָב־ לִ֫בּ֥וֹ דְבָרָ֥יו רַכּ֖וּ מִשֶּׁ֗מֶן וְהֵ֣מָּה פְתִחֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: pîw ḥā·lə·qū maḥ·mā·’ōṯ ū·qă·rāḇ- lib·bōw ḏə·ḇā·rāw rak·kū miš·še·men wə·hêm·māh p̄ə·ṯi·ḥō·wṯ
verses.literal: His speech is smooth as butter but war is in his heart His words are softer than oil yet they are swords unsheathed

verses.original: הַשְׁלֵ֤ךְ יְהָבְךָ֮ עַל־ יְהוָ֨ה׀ וְה֪וּא יְכַ֫לְכְּלֶ֥ךָ לֹא־ לְעוֹלָ֥ם יִתֵּ֖ן לַצַּדִּֽיק׃ מ֗וֹט
verses.transliteration: haš·lêḵ yə·hā·ḇə·ḵā ‘al- Yah·weh wə·hū yə·ḵal·kə·le·ḵā lō- lə·‘ō·w·lām yit·tên laṣ·ṣad·dîq mō·wṭ
verses.literal: Cast your burden upon the LORD and He will sustain you He will never . . . let the righteous be shaken

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֤ה אֱלֹהִ֨ים׀ תּוֹרִדֵ֬ם׀ לִבְאֵ֬ר שַׁ֗חַת אַנְשֵׁ֤י דָמִ֣ים וּ֭מִרְמָה לֹא־ יֶחֱצ֣וּ יְמֵיהֶ֑ם וַ֝אֲנִ֗י אֶבְטַח־ בָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh ’ĕ·lō·hîm tō·w·ri·ḏêm liḇ·’êr ša·ḥaṯ ’an·šê ḏā·mîm ū·mir·māh lō- ye·ḥĕ·ṣū yə·mê·hem wa·’ă·nî ’eḇ·ṭaḥ- bāḵ
verses.literal: But You O God will bring them down to the Pit of destruction men of bloodshed and deceit will not live out half their days But I will trust in You
